title: Remove the dead dashboardChildNextReward pipeline — result is computed but never displayed
why: ChildPointsRewardsTabCard.build() never reads nextRewardAsync (the field appears only in its own declaration, confirmed by grep); its own doc comment admits 'this value is no longer displayed' (DEC-32/R4o-M1). Its only caller (dashboard_body.dart:394) still watches dashboardChildNextRewardProvider, which for every active track sequentially awaits two DB calls (getTrackPointsTotalForRewards, getMilestonesForTrack) in an N+1 loop, plus stripStockMilestonesEffect, getGlobalPointsForRewards, and getGlobalMilestones — real Drift I/O executed on every child-profile dashboard render purely to build a value that is thrown away.
recommendation: Delete the nextRewardAsync parameter from ChildPointsRewardsTabCard and the ref.watch(dashboardChildNextRewardProvider) call in dashboard_body.dart; if the feature is truly product-cut, also delete dashboardChildNextReward, DashboardChildNextReward, and NextRewardSelector/next_reward_selector.dart, updating the ref.invalidate call sites in dashboard_screen.dart, reward_config_controller.dart, and after_track_change_invalidation.dart in the same change.
acceptance_criteria: grep -rn nextRewardAsync lib/ returns nothing after cleanup, or shows a real read.
If the provider is deleted, flutter analyze is clean (no dangling ref.invalidate targets) and all three invalidation call sites are updated in the same PR.
